name: refuse-fit-below-scatter
why: A circle with 0.3 mm of noise on every point fitted at 0.01 mm. Below the scatter there is nothing smooth to fit: the fitter adds knots until it has one per point and gives up. The refusal measures the tolerance that does hold, doubling up from the one asked, and names it - the author's next edit is a number, not a guess.

message_contains: could not be fitted within 0.01 mm
